verdict.rationale: Sentry documents 'Billing Quota Management' and 'Advanced quota management' as pricing-tier features, indicating per-project event quotas and spend controls exist, but the evidence pack lacks detail on how spend caps are configured, alerting on quota thresholds, or hard-stop billing guarantees. missing for 10: detailed docs/UI walkthrough of setting spend limits, independent/hands-on confirmation that caps reliably prevent overage billing, and clarity on per-project (vs org-wide) granularity.
